content: Work/portfolio is the sales engine. Socialtables/Cvent: photos, video, testimonials, awards, about, social links; avoid 100-photo dumps. Showit: featured events with short captions, mix of hero + grid. Verlua case-study pattern (challenge/solution/results) wins when real metrics exist; live GCC sites mix project galleries (Spectrum Latest Work) and thin case cards (Arvento). Extraordinary uses event-type pages not a dump. For v1 with placeholder assets: curated Work grid of 6–8 case cards (title, category, still) that look replaceable; defer live filters, CMS, and metric-heavy case studies until real photography and client permission exist.
